Subject: SIG/CAIQ intake - scheduling

Hi Vanessa,

We're kicking off the vendor intake for SIG/CAIQ for Cygnus Health. Our procurement and security teams would like an initial intake call to go over scope, deliverables, and a rough timeline. Attached is a brief SIG request form (pdf) with the list of documents we usually request up front.

High-level ask: can we schedule a 45-60 minute intake next week? Prefer mornings PST. The areas we'll need coverage on for the call: data residency, encryption at rest/in transit, logging/retention, and access controls (IAM/SAML).

I've looped in Jim Park (procurement) and Tom Baker (security operations). If you can share a short evidence matrix before the call (or a link to one) that helps speed the sync. Thanks!

Laura Chen
Head of Information Security
Cygnus Health

Proposed slots (PST):
• Tue 11/10 09:00–10:00
• Tue 11/10 11:00–12:00
• Wed 11/11 09:30–10:30

Suggested agenda (30–45m):
1) Introductions + scope confirmation (5m)
2) Review SIG/CAIQ sections you care most about (10m)
3) Document/evidence mapping and owners (15m)
4) Timeline & next steps (5m)

Let me know which slot works and if you prefer any additional folks on the call.

Thanks — Tue 11/10 11:00–12:00 PST works for us.

A couple of clarifications so the call is efficient:
• Please be ready to discuss data residency options (we'll need to confirm EU data flow restrictions for a subset of customers).
• We will want a brief mapping to SOC 2 controls for the CAIQ items (so bring the SOC 2 pointer).
• Can you confirm whether you support an HSM-backed KMS for key management (if not, what the encryption key rotation looks like)?
• Sample logging/retention artifacts would be helpful — e.g. an example retention policy and one syslog sample.

Also cc'ing Jim Park from procurement who will raise contractual questions (BAA / data processing).

Appreciate it — Laura
